event_name: Date 16 November 2019 Time 14:04 2019 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 14 - 17 November 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 16 & 17) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Alleged Impeding of car 8 in turn 10.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the drivers of Car 11 (Sergio Perez) and Car 8 (Romain Grosjean) and the team representatives. Both drivers were on slow laps with Grosjean about to enter the pits, and Perez was setting up for a fast lap. While the interaction between the cars was "untidy", neither was particularly disadvantaged and the Stewards agreed that it was not dangerous. Therefore the Stewards agreed that No Further Action was necessary.
rules_referenced: Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 11 Incident With Car 8 In Turn 10
